Model years are simulation indices. Observed inclusive reach and seasonal confinement bounds do not establish complete current bottoms. Local monthly maxima retain shallow sampling censoring, record gaps and short-record caveats. Indian Ocean references distinguish regional geostrophic reach, transport integration depth and a source-reported scale distance. Distinct SICC/SECC identities and historical WAC naming do not authorize whole-route depth inheritance. Regional water-mass depth is distinct from a kinematic boundary. Australian southern-limb seasonal water-mass interfaces remain partial component evidence, including conditional summer context for a catalog winter system. Parent system discovery retains member ownership without assigning a scalar system depth. Four Malvinas source descriptions retain upstream approach, branch/local-maximum roles, crossing periods and shallow sampling limits. They are not a simultaneous along-route bottom profile or seasonal extrema. Twenty-four derived EAC descriptors summarize twelve current-following calendar-mean regional profiles, preserving thresholds, native shallow edges, statistical extension and unpropagated uncertainty. They are not new independent observations or whole-current physical geometry.
